scope: Complete missing natural monster recovery damage-credit/keeper branches and their per-viewer colour notifications. Functional port against inherited implementation; not certification of publisher balance or whole-server completeness.

history_review_before_editing.finding: Initial .NET RecoverMonster updates only HP/MP; credit decay and keeper release were omitted. AddDamage's existing ownership threshold is retained.
Preserve mode ACKs, LastAtkTick and recovery-anchor updates only when entering battle. The commit explicitly deferred GetColor; colour notifications are now appended after the existing mode packet.
Keep HostKey-based O(1) AI cancellation. Recovery neither cancels AI nor rebuilds any queue.
Keep InvenLock/LeaveCount and the existing loot-window protections. Keeper release changes only keeper ID/type.
Keep guild damage attribution and the C# fix clearing Occupied when a fort war starts. Replace only the documented constant-zero colour packet on capture.

implementation_references.rule: On an eligible natural HP pass: ratio = actualHPgain / pre-recoveryHPdeficit as float32; each damage and guild bucket becomes uint32(damage - damage*ratio), with zero entries erased. Release keeper at maxHP - floor(maxHP*MONKEEP_PER/100), MONKEEP_PER=10. Send HP/MP before any keeper-change colour.
Changes keeper type and ID only; does not clear aggro, hosts, targets or loot-window state.
Priority: effective faction ally/enemy; neutral go-home; matching party/private keeper; another keeper; battle; first-attack AI; peaceful. Colour IDs are 0/3/2/3/1/3/3/2 respectively.
Send existing mode ACK, followed by per-viewer colour.
Wire body is byte objectType, uint32 objectID, byte colour, byte country; no new protocol fields.
Consumes the same body and updates the object's colour/country.

retained_behavior: Existing STOPRECOVER/action gates, HPR/MPR modifiers, recovery timing and saturating HP/MP arithmetic.
MP-only healing and direct healing outside natural Recover do not adjust damage credit or release a keeper.
An eligible HP pass with an HPR modifier producing zero gain retains damage credit but still checks the native keeper-release threshold.
Aggro, host/target, loot locks and AI epoch remain intact on full recovery.
Existing AI acquisition/binding logic is unchanged. Colour uses a loaded script's native AiType flag; script-less monsters use the existing Aggressive value as a fallback.
Private and party damage keys stay separate, with each remaining bucket truncated independently. Explicit ratio-zero/full endpoints avoid float rounding overflow at uint32 extremes.

validation.platform: Isolated Linux .NET 10 SDK container; source and host NuGet cache mounted read-only

remaining_verification: Play the claim, disengage/recover, re-claim and loot sequence with multiple real clients, including parties and opposing factions.
Verify colour changes through actual fort capture and AI mode transitions in the pinned client.
Establish independent compatible publisher/pinned-client evidence for server-side recovery thresholds and credit arithmetic; inherited C++ is an implementation reference.
